$comment: Lane B suite runners (TASK-011; devops-owned; security-critical path tools/quality/**). Maps manifest suite ids (tools/quality/required-suites.json, qa-lead) to how quality:heavy runs them. kind jest: one Jest run per suite (paths are Jest path patterns, placed before --selectProjects; integration/api run in band with a raised --testTimeout). kind command: cmd array without a shell; placeholders {node}, {npm}, {root}, {junit}, {native}; converter junit|k6|lighthouse|zap|trivy|gitleaks|stryker; native_report = allow-listed file name. A suite that becomes active in the manifest without an entry here is reported as an error (FAIL). testcontainers_images: the harness images whose digests summary.json records (prisma/tests/harness/postgres.ts, apps/api/src/platform/health/health.int.test.ts). coverage: true = the run (whole projects only: no paths, no testNamePattern) writes istanbul coverage-final.json for the merge. merged_coverage (D-ORCH-047, PR #33 R1-m4): after all suites, quality:heavy merges the coverage of every project that measures source (projects always; projects_if_suites while jest --listTests finds a test file), runs any required project no selected suite covered, and appends the US-006 gate, the jest.config.ts tripwire and, at profile pr, the diff gate to the JUnit of suite; npm run test:coverage (tools/ci/coverage-run.mjs) reads the same list.
